reason: A build and packaging utility for distributing DeepSeek Harness with a bundled Node.js runtime, plugins, native WebView launchers, and platform-specific installers and packages.

summaries.zh: 用于将 DeepSeek Harness 与 Node.js 运行时及插件打包为跨平台桌面启动器、归档文件和安装包的构建工具。
summaries.en: A build tool that packages DeepSeek Harness with a Node.js runtime and plugins into cross-platform desktop launchers, archives, and installers.

capabilities: Packages DeepSeek Harness with a private Node.js runtime and DSH plugins
Builds cross-platform GUI launchers and portable archives
Creates macOS DMG, Windows NSIS, and Linux DEB/RPM packages
Downloads Node.js and package dependencies over the network
Can perform macOS application and DMG signing when configured
